svg.title: GRC Lake Snowflake security data lake architecture
svg.desc: A lane-based architecture diagram showing Snowflake streaming ingestion, governed Iceberg tables, dynamic tables, GRC Lake continuous evaluation, and closed-loop remediation.

g.text: Snowflake Security Data Lake for GRC Lake
Enterprise-governed evidence, streaming ingest, Iceberg interoperability, and continuous trust evaluation in the customer's boundary.
Customer-owned database, roles, policies, and retention.
fresh control rollups · SLA windows · owner metrics
row access policies · masking policies · warehouse RBAC · query history
GRC Lake reads with least privilege, writes assessment state, and keeps remediation auditable.
